sources.title: Mixture-of-Agents Enhances Large Language Model Capabilities
sources.summary: Layered proposer and aggregator ensembles improve the authors’ instruction-following evaluations. This establishes output aggregation as prior art; it does not isolate model diversity from model quality, token spending, or aggregator strength.
sources.limitations: Instruction-following evaluations are not persistent swarm recovery or a matched-cost Jev comparison.
sources.session_read_depth: abstract / README; selected sections where stated

sources.title: Rethinking Mixture-of-Agents: Is Mixing Different Large Language Models Beneficial?
sources.summary: Repeated sampling from the strongest proposer often beats mixed proposers. The authors examine output quality and diversity jointly, including specialized tasks; cross-model mixtures sometimes help but diversity alone does not justify weaker proposals.
sources.limitations: Include a best-model repeated-sampling baseline; results do not establish that all heterogeneous stateful teams lose.
sources.session_read_depth: abstract plus selected full-text introduction/methods passages; not a full paper read

sources.title: LLM-Blender: Ensembling Large Language Models with Pairwise Ranking and Generative Fusion
sources.summary: The authors combine a learned pairwise ranker with a generative fuser to exploit differences among candidate answers. Their experiments show improvements over individual models and comparison ensembles on their evaluation suite.
sources.limitations: Learned selection and fusion are established; ranking quality and evaluator bias require separate controls.
sources.session_read_depth: abstract / README; selected sections where stated

sources.title: RouteLLM: Learning to Route LLMs with Preference Data
sources.summary: Preference-trained routers select between stronger and weaker models to reduce inference cost while preserving response quality in reported benchmarks. The authors also test transfer when the underlying models change.
sources.limitations: Query routing is already studied; a swarm question needs state, feedback, interactions or resource contention beyond independent queries.
sources.session_read_depth: abstract / README; selected sections where stated

sources.title: Small LLMs Are Weak Tool Learners: A Multi-LLM Agent
sources.summary: Planner, caller and summarizer capabilities are separated and trained in stages. The resulting modular multi-LLM system improves reported tool-use performance relative to a single-model approach on the evaluated benchmarks.
sources.limitations: Division into specialist modules is established; training and scaffold changes confound a simple model-size explanation.
sources.session_read_depth: abstract / README; selected sections where stated

sources.title: MasRouter: Learning to Route LLMs for Multi-Agent Systems
sources.summary: A cascaded controller chooses collaboration mode, roles and models jointly. Reported reasoning and coding evaluations improve cost-performance, making generic heterogeneous routing and automatic role assignment direct prior art for this project.
sources.limitations: Compare a new adaptive allocator to learned routing and simple deterministic assignment; training cost matters.
sources.session_read_depth: abstract / README; selected sections where stated

sources.title: Which Models Work Well Together? Measuring Heterogeneity for LLM Team Selection
sources.summary: Offline profiling combines quality, error decorrelation and predictive divergence to select teams. The paper reports gains over quality-only selection and explicitly includes held-out distribution-shift evaluation, so merely adding held-out tasks is insufficient novelty.
sources.limitations: Methods use normalized option-token log probabilities. Jev probabilities and verbalized confidence are not automatically comparable; study interaction-induced correlation instead.
sources.session_read_depth: abstract plus selected full-text introduction/methods passages; not a full paper read

sources.title: HieraMAS: Optimizing Intra-Node LLM Mixtures and Inter-Node Topology for Multi-Agent Systems
sources.summary: Functional roles contain heterogeneous proposer-synthesizer mixtures, while a learned procedure selects communication topology and assigns reward across levels. Reasoning and coding results support combining within-role mixtures with between-role structure.
sources.limitations: A composite Jev/LLM cell is not inherently new. Isolate the typed decision boundary or temporal mechanism.
sources.session_read_depth: abstract / README; selected sections where stated

sources.title: The Collaboration Tax: How Much LLM Multi-Agent Systems Pay to Coordinate
sources.summary: The authors measure decentralization loss on 32 cooperative tasks using 11 models. Their account identifies failures of grounding, asking, integrating and re-deriving, and reports capability-dependent behavior in heterogeneous pairs.
sources.limitations: Consulted v2 abstract; reported conference status was not independently verified. Two-agent findings do not directly establish large-swarm behavior.
sources.session_read_depth: abstract / README; selected sections where stated

sources.title: Guided Collaboration in Heterogeneous LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems via Entropy-Based Understanding Assessment and Experience Retrieval
sources.summary: The authors report cases where strong-weak pairings underperform weak-weak pairings. Adaptive guidance intensity and retrieved experiences improve their evaluated reasoning, coding and routing tasks, motivating explicit tests of interface mismatch.
sources.limitations: Entropy-based understanding is a proxy; distinguish better communication from extra context or inference.
sources.session_read_depth: abstract / README; selected sections where stated

sources.title: ReConcile: Round-Table Conference Improves Reasoning via Consensus among Diverse LLMs
sources.summary: Diverse models exchange answers, explanations and confidence over multiple rounds before confidence-weighted voting. The authors report reasoning improvements on seven benchmarks and analyze contributions from model diversity and discussion components.
sources.limitations: Confidence weighting and mixed-model debate are established. Benefits need task-specific replication and equal-budget alternatives.
sources.session_read_depth: abstract / README; selected sections where stated

sources.title: Diversity Collapse in Multi-Agent LLM Systems: Structural Coupling and Collective Failure in Open-Ended Idea Generation
sources.summary: The authors identify reduced semantic diversity associated with authority and dense communication in multi-agent ideation. They attribute premature convergence to interaction structure rather than only weak individual models.
sources.limitations: Ideation diversity is not decision correctness. Preserve minority evidence without assuming all disagreement is beneficial.
sources.session_read_depth: abstract / README; selected sections where stated

sources.title: From Debate to Decision: Conformal Social Choice for Safe Multi-Agent Deliberation
sources.summary: A conformal decision layer aggregates heterogeneous debate probabilities and routes uncertain cases to escalation. Evaluations include Haiku, DeepSeek and Qwen; increased accuracy among automated decisions is explicitly a selection effect.
sources.limitations: Marginal conformal coverage requires its calibration assumptions; it is not conditional safety or robustness to changing partners and feedback.
sources.session_read_depth: abstract / README; selected sections where stated

sources.title: When Is Diversity Rewarded in Cooperative Multi-Agent Learning?
sources.summary: The study relates reward aggregation curvature to gains from heterogeneous effort allocation, then tests related reward structures in MARL. Richer observations can remove empirical heterogeneity gains by enabling identical policies to behave differently.
sources.limitations: This concerns allocation and learned behavior, not vendor identity. Include homogeneous policies with different observations or roles.
sources.session_read_depth: abstract plus selected full-text introduction/methods passages; not a full paper read

sources.title: Adaptive Task Allocation for Heterogeneous Multi-Robot Teams with Evolving and Unknown Robot Capabilities
sources.summary: Robots update specialization estimates from progress and reassign tasks when capabilities are unknown or change. Simulations and physical experiments demonstrate adaptive allocation under changing conditions without requiring an explicit environment model.
sources.limitations: Adaptive specialization is established in robotics. Transfer to delayed, noisy language-agent feedback is a testable extension.
sources.session_read_depth: abstract / README; selected sections where stated

sources.title: Cowpox: Towards the Immunity of VLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
sources.summary: A small defender-controlled population spreads corrective retrieval content against infectious attacks in vision-language agent networks. The work establishes minority defensive intervention and conditional recovery dynamics as close prior art.
sources.limitations: Retrieval-image contagion differs from typed tool decisions. Diversity preservation, false quarantine and correlated detector failure remain essential controls.
sources.session_read_depth: abstract / README; selected sections where stated

sources.title: Introducing System One Models & Jev
sources.summary: TypeSafe describes Jev as a typed decision model with probabilistic outputs, rather than a string generator. Its workflow demonstrations motivate separating proposal generation from selection and measuring their costs independently.
sources.limitations: Vendor evidence; schema validity does not imply semantic correctness, calibration under shift or immunity to manipulated state.
sources.session_read_depth: abstract / README; selected sections where stated

sources.title: TypeSafe API reference: Systemone
sources.summary: The public API describes shared state and named typed questions in a request, returned with model and usage metadata. This supports a common adapter boundary for choices, binary judgments and scores.
sources.limitations: Documentation is an interface contract, not performance evidence. Discover and pin an available model before any run; do not freeze an unversioned alias as if immutable.
sources.session_read_depth: abstract / README; selected sections where stated

sources.title: How we built our multi-agent research system
sources.summary: The engineering account describes a lead agent and parallel research workers, context separation and substantial token expenditure. Its internal evaluation motivates careful accounting for parallelism, evidence access and compute when comparing teams.
sources.limitations: Vendor internal evaluation; it does not isolate heterogeneous model identity as the cause of improvement.
sources.session_read_depth: abstract / README; selected sections where stated

sources.title: CoffeeBench: Benchmarking Long-Horizon LLM Agents in Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Economies
sources.summary: A six-firm simulated supply chain evaluates long-horizon business behavior with different roles and dependencies. The project provides a realistic direction for studying inter-agent contracts, inventory, payments and recovery.
sources.limitations: Role heterogeneity does not itself identify a benefit from mixing models. Full 90-day trajectories are expensive compared with a bounded mechanism test.
sources.session_read_depth: abstract / README; selected sections where stated

sources.title: jev-skill: Jev supervision of local SLM workers
sources.summary: The repository describes Qwen workers governed by Jev architecture choices and contract checks, alongside syntax validation and example games. It directly precedes the proposed broad Jev-plus-small-model integration.
sources.limitations: README inspected, not executed. Small self-reported demonstrations and multiple simultaneous scaffold changes do not establish causal model-diversity gains.
sources.session_read_depth: abstract / README; selected sections where stated

sources.title: jev-sentinel: per-action scope monitoring
sources.summary: The project inserts Jev judgments before agent actions and reviews tool results for scope changes. It is a direct implementation precedent for a Jev sentinel attached to generative agents.
sources.limitations: README inspected, not executed. The claim that typed outputs prevent persuasion is not an established robustness guarantee.
sources.session_read_depth: abstract / README; selected sections where stated

sources.title: autojev: Qwen-based typed decision model
sources.summary: A released implementation uses a Qwen backbone for supplied-choice probabilities and offers a TypeSafe-compatible service. The README reports supervised fine-tuning and separate temperature calibration, with code and model links.
sources.limitations: Not run; exact curated training data are not bundled. Reported benchmark gains are author claims, not an independent replication.
sources.session_read_depth: abstract / README; selected sections where stated

sources.title: RouteLLM: serving and evaluating LLM routers
sources.summary: The released routing framework provides an implementation baseline for deciding between stronger and weaker language models. It is a practical comparator for cost-aware model selection before introducing swarm-specific coordination policies.
sources.limitations: README only; installation, model availability and reproducibility were not tested.
sources.session_read_depth: abstract / README; selected sections where stated

sources.title: MoA: Together Mixture-of-Agents implementation
sources.summary: This repository provides the layered proposer-and-aggregator architecture accompanying Mixture-of-Agents. It is a useful existing baseline for output aggregation and for distinguishing additional samples from additional model families.
sources.limitations: README only; no example executed. Historic model endpoints may need replacements that change replication scope.
sources.session_read_depth: abstract / README; selected sections where stated

sources.title: When the Right Answer Is Missing: An Arithmetic-Dependent Rejection Bottleneck in Jev
sources.summary: Paired arithmetic tests reveal poor rejection when the correct answer is absent despite strong answer-present performance. Boolean verification and a threshold tuned on separate development problems mitigate the reported failure.
sources.limitations: This already answers the basic missing-option question. Test cross-model menu repair under non-arithmetic distribution shift only as an extension.
sources.session_read_depth: abstract

sources.title: Deadline-Driven Hierarchical Agentic Resource Sharing for AI Services and RAN Functions in AI-RAN
sources.summary: A slow LLM placement agent and fast convex allocator coordinate shared compute, with a critic screening disruptive migrations. The reported experiments show improved deadline fulfillment across varying load conditions.
sources.limitations: Multirate agent control and migration costs are established. Jev is not automatically preferable to the fast exact allocator.
sources.session_read_depth: abstract

sources.title: Capability Advertisement as a Market for Lemons: A Trust Layer for Heterogeneous Agent Networks
sources.summary: The author models unreliable capability advertisements as a market-for-lemons problem and proposes probabilistic capability descriptions, screening and reputation. Reliability composition and incentive conditions are central to the argument.
sources.limitations: Theory and proposed architecture, not independent proof that the trust layer works for Jev/Qwen teams.
sources.session_read_depth: abstract

sources.title: Width, Memory, and Delay: A Resource Accounting for the Limits of Flat Multi-Agent Systems
sources.summary: The repository reports control simulations separating agent count, internal memory and delay. A matched internal-model flat controller can beat a hierarchy; its language-agent results are explicitly deterministic mocks, not model evidence.
sources.limitations: README only, code not run. Broad hierarchy claims are already contested; match total memory and include adaptive classical controllers.
